description: This file is a shell script for testing Git merge-base performance and functionality. It defines functions to build complex commit histories with merges, sets up test repositories, and runs performance tests for Git commands such as 'git merge-base' and 'git show-branch'.

methods.name: build_history
methods.description: Creates a commit history with a specified depth and merge pattern, used to simulate complex repository states.

methods.name: build_history2
methods.description: Creates an alternative commit history with the same roots but different merge structure to test merge-base calculations.
